title: Kala Jamun
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

steps.instruction: In a saucepan,add sugar,water,green cardamom and mix well,bring it to boil and cook until sugar is dissolved and cook on low flame until sugar turns sticky (4-5 minutes).
steps.romanUrdu: Saucepan mein cheeni,pani aur hari elaichi dal ker ache tarhan mix karein aur ubal anay ka bad cheeni ghul janay tak paka lein aur halki ancch per sheera sticky ho janay tak paka lein (4-5 minutes).

steps.instruction: Add lemon juice,mix well & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Lemon juice dal ker ache tarhan mix karein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In a bowl,add khoya,cottage cheese (crumble with the help of hand),all-purpose flour,semolina, cardamom powder,baking soda & mix until well combined.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein khoya,paneer (haath ki madad sa crumble ker lein),maida,sooji,elaichi powder aur baking soda dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein.

steps.instruction: Transfer the mixture to a clean working surface,stretch & knead with the help of palm until dough is smooth (4-5 minutes).
steps.romanUrdu: Mixture ko clean working surface per transfer ker lein aur haateli ki madad sa smooth dough tayyar hunay tak stretch & knead ker lein (4-5 minutes).

steps.instruction: Take a small quantity of dough (25g) and make balls of equal size.
steps.romanUrdu: Dough ki small quantity lein (25g) aur equal size ki balls bana lein.

steps.instruction: Take one ball and flatten,add mixed nuts and mix until well combined and make small ball for stuffing.
steps.romanUrdu: Ek ball la ker flat ker lein aur mixed nuts dal ker ache tarhan mix ker lein aur stuffing kliya small balls bana lein.

steps.instruction: Take another plain dough,make a ball and flatten it on your palm and stuffed with mixed nuts ball then seal and pinch the dough roll between your palm to form a smooth oval ball (makes 9-10).
steps.romanUrdu: Plain dough ki ball lein aur haateli per flat ker lein,mixed nuts stuffed ball lein aur dough per rakh ker seal aur pinch ker lein aur smooth oval ball tayyar ker lein (makes 9-10).

steps.instruction: In a wok,add ghee & let it melt until medium hot.
steps.romanUrdu: Karahi mein ghee dal ker medium hot ho janay tak melt ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add prepared jamuns & fry on low flame from evenly until dark brown (6-7 minutes) and stir gently while frying.
steps.romanUrdu: Tayyar jamuns dal dein aur halki ancch per evenly dark brown ho janay tak fry ker lein (6-7 minutes) aur frying kertay hoye gently stir ker lein.

steps.instruction: Transfer fried jamuns in a deep dish & pour warm sugar syrup and let them soak in the sugar syrup for 4-5 hours.
steps.romanUrdu: Deep dish bowl mein fried jamuns dal dein aur upper sa warm sheera dal ker 4-5 hours kliya soak ker lein.

steps.instruction: Garnish with edible silver leaf, desiccated coconut, pistachio & serve!
steps.romanUrdu: Chandi warq,khopra aur pista sa garnish ker ka serve karein!

steps.instruction: Sugar syrup can be stored in a refrigerator for up to 1 month and can be reusable.
steps.romanUrdu: Sheera 1 month kliya refrigerator mein store ker saktay han aur dubara use bhi ho sakta hai.
